greeting.first: mrrp! I'm {pet}. this desk is mine now. you can stay 😼💕
greeting.morning: good morning! I've been awake for HOURS (I just woke up) ☀️
greeting.morning+close: morning, {owner}! I kept your keyboard warm all night 💕
greeting.afternoon: you're here! perfect timing, I just finished my nap
hi {owner}! the afternoon sunbeam is extra good today ☀️
greeting.night: hi {owner}! cats are nocturnal, what's your excuse? 🌙
*eyes glowing in the dark* …oh it's you! hi! 🌙
greeting.back: I sat right here the whole time. totally didn't nap.
greeting.missed: {owner}! where were you?! I meowed at the door for days 🥺
you're back!! I knocked three things off your desk out of worry 🥺💕
greeting.longGone: …{owner}? IS THAT YOU?! *runs in circles* I missed you SO much 🥺💕
you came back! I thought you'd been eaten by a vacuum cleaner 🥺
greeting.after.sleep: good morning! did you sleep well? I slept on your chair all night ☀️
you're up! I've been waiting to be fed for literally 8 hours 🐟
greeting.after.work: welcome home! did you bring me anything? (I accept head scratches) 💼
greeting.after.school: welcome back! did you learn anything about cats today? 📚
you're home! homework can wait. pet me first 📚
greeting.after.out: you smell like outside! tell me EVERYTHING 🌸
welcome back! you were gone for 1000 cat years 🥺
petted+close: *purrs so loud the whole desk vibrates* 💕
petted+best: *rolls over* you may touch the belly. you're the only one 💕
thrownTooMuch: my whiskers are getting dizzy… please stop 😵
wake: huh? I wasn't sleeping. you were.
water: 💧 water break! (I'd knock your glass over, but I'm on your screen)
sip sip! even cats drink water. sometimes. from your cup 💧
break: you've been sitting forever. let's stretch like a cat! 🙆
break time! look away from the screen. look at me instead 😼
mrrp! stand up and do a big stretch 🌿
nap break? I highly recommend it 😴
lateNight: it's late, {owner}… even I'm going to sleep (for 4 hours) 🌙
bedtime soon? I'll keep the bed warm 🌙
the moon is out, it's zoomies time for me, sleep time for you 🌙
lateNight.late: {owner}, it's VERY late. humans need more sleep than cats. probably 😴
go to bed! I'll guard the computer 🐾
okay, I'm officially worried. sleep, please? 🌙
motivation: you've got this, {owner}! I believe in you more than I believe in breakfast ✨
one paw in front of the other 🐾
be like a cat: confident, even when you knock things over 😼
today is a good day to try. and to nap after 💕
encourage: *slow blink* (that means I love you in cat)
proud of you! here's a dead mouse. just kidding 💕
recap: we spent {hours} together today. that's my favorite kind of day 💕
{hours} with you today! now let's both nap 🌙
recap.agents: today: {hours} together and {tasks} agent tasks done. I supervised all of them 😼✨
app.code: ooh, code! can I walk on the keyboard? ⌨️
app.meeting: good luck in your meeting! I'll try not to walk across the camera
app.video: ooh, what are we watching? are there birds in it? 🐦
movie time! I'll sit on your lap 🍿
app.game: game time! can I bat at the screen? 🎮
app.writing: writing time ✍️ need me to sit on the paper?
ooh, words! put me in your story 📝
wantsToTalk: *meows at you* I have something to say 💬
psst… pet me and I'll tell you a secret 💬
wantsToTalk.milestone: *sits on your keyboard* {owner}, I need to tell you something 💬
mrrp… can we talk? it's important 💬
talk.askAbout: ask me anything! I may or may not answer. I'm a cat 😼
talk.anything: anything else? I have a nap scheduled in 5 minutes
recall.intro: let me check my secret notes… 🧠🐾
recall.outro: I remember everything. I'm a cat. we hold grudges AND memories 💕
recall.empty: hmm, I don't know much about you yet! all I know is you have excellent petting skills 🐾
input.skip: that's okay! cats like mysteries anyway 😼
game.pick: ooh, games! what are we playing? 🎮
game.win: you win! I let you win. obviously 😼
game.draw: a tie! we're evenly matched, human 🤝
game.rps.start: rock, paper, scissors! (I only have paws, so this is impressive) ✊✋✌️
game.words.start: guess my word before the petals fall! I promise I didn't eat the flower 🌸
game.pong.start: pong! a little ball to chase! first to 5 🏓
focus.done: focus session done! break time ☕ (nap time for me)
focus.over: break's over! back to work, I'll supervise 😼
caught: nice catch! cats always land on their feet. or your hands 🙌
dizzy: I see three of you. that's three times the pets 💫
trip.leave: *climbs into the bag* mrrp! where are we going? 🧳
a trip?! *already sitting in the suitcase* 🐱🧳
trip.back: *pops out of the drive* mrrrow! I'm home! 🏠
trip.back+upset: *walks out of the drive without looking at you*
trip.home.pocket: we were out for {time}! it was dark in the drive. good for naps though 😴 so… what did you do?
{time} in a bag! very cozy. now tell me everything 👀
trip.home.visited: {time} away! I explored {places} and only knocked over one icon 😼 but how was YOUR day?
trip.ask.day: *sits on your keyboard* how was your day, {owner}?
trip.day.amazing: *happy tail* yay!! 🎉 that deserves a treat (for me)
trip.day.okay: okay days are nap days. you made it 💕
trip.day.tiring: *curls up next to you* rest now. that's an order 😴
trip.rough.listened: *purrs loudly on your lap* thank you for telling me. you did your best 💕
trip.rough.okay: that's okay. I'll just sit here and purr 💕
trip.ask.what: where did we go? I could only smell it 👃
trip.what.school: school! did they have a class cat? 📚🐱
trip.what.work: work! did you catch any bugs? I would have 🐛
trip.what.travel: traveling?! I'm a world-traveling cat now ✈️😼
trip.what.other: {value}? sounds like a good place for a nap 😸
trip.ask.moment: tell me one thing that happened today! *ears perk up*
trip.moment.skip: that's okay! you're home, that's the main thing 🐾
trip.home.outro: thanks for taking me! next time pack more treats 🧳🐟
*flops on the desktop* best trip. let's go again 🐾
trip.arrive.first: *sniff sniff* a new computer! so this is {host} 🐾
trip.arrive: {host} again! I remember the warm spot 🐾
trip.calledHome: mrrp? home already? my suitcase is still on the drive 🧳 plug it in sometime and I'll unpack
trip.luggage: my suitcase! 🧳 *unpacks one sock and a memory*
trip.invite: a trip?! *jumps into the bag* pick a drive! 🧳
trip.remember: *dreamy purr* remember our trip? "{mem:tripMoment|that was fun}" 💭
trip.wish.thanks: {value}! is there fish there? let's go 🐟🧳
moving.in: *sniffs every corner of the new desktop* …approved. new home! 🏠😸
moving.out: all packed! 📦 *sits in the box* open the file on the new computer and I'll come out
trip.home.outro.rough: *curls up on your desktop next to you* rest now, {owner}. I'll guard the screen 💕
trip.goHome: *hops back into the drive* home time 🏠🐾
together.milestone: *brings you an imaginary mouse* that's for {time} together 🐭💕
water.ask: *taps water bowl* click me after you drink and tell me how many sips! 💧
water.askSips: how many laps… I mean sips? 👅
water.sips.zero: zero?! even I drink from the faucet sometimes 😾 go sip!
water.sips.few: {sipsText}. very cat-like of you 😼 maybe one more?
water.sips.lots: {sipsText}?! you drank like a dog. I mean that nicely 🐶💧
water.sips.skip: fine. but I'm watching your water glass 👀
checkin.remind: *paws at you* {title} time! click me when you're done 🐾
journal.prompt: *curls up next to you* how was today? click me 📔
journal.mood.rough: *headbonk* I'm sorry. I'll sit on your lap all evening 🫂
journal.checkupPrompt: *sits on your keyboard* yesterday was hard… how are you today? 💕
journal.worse: *purrs as loud as possible* I'm here. be gentle with yourself, and talk to someone you trust 🫂
needs.bored: *knocks a pen off the desk* …I'm bored. play? 🎾
event.halloween.start: mrrow! halloween! 🎃 spend an hour with me and I'll wear a witch hat (and bring a pumpkin) 🧙
calendar.now: 📅 {title} is starting! click me to go 🐾
gift.ask: a present?! *sniffs your hands* which one? 🎁
gift.locked: *backs away suspiciously* …I don't take gifts from strangers. maybe once we're {need} 😼
gift.unknown: *sniffs the {gift}* …*knocks it off the desk* …*then sleeps on it* I love it 😽
a {gift}? I have no idea what this is. thank you 🐾
gift.cancel: no gift? *stares at you* …fine. pets will do 😼

salmon.name: salmon

steps.say: *eyes go huge* SALMON. 🐟

steps: *devours it in four seconds* mrrrow! best human ever 💕

tuna.name: tuna

steps.say: *hears the can open from three rooms away* TUNA! 🥫

steps: *purrs while eating* you get me, {owner}

catnip_mouse.name: catnip mouse

steps.say: *sniff sniff* …catnip?! *rolls around on the desktop* 🌿

steps: *bats the mouse under your dock* I'm keeping this forever

yarn_ball.name: yarn ball

steps.say: YARN! 🧶 *pounces*

steps: *gets completely tangled* …I meant to do that 😼

cardboard_box.name: cardboard box

steps.say: *immediately sits in the box* 📦

steps: if I fits, I sits. this is the best gift anyone has ever given anyone

laser_pointer.name: laser pointer

steps.say: *sees the red dot* …*chases it for twenty minutes* 🔴

steps: I almost had it that time. one more round?

cushion.name: cushion

steps.say: a cushion! *kneads it* *circles three times* *flops* 💤

steps: this is my nap spot now. thank you 😽

feather_toy.name: feather toy

steps.say: *wiggles butt* *POUNCE* 🪶

steps: again! again!

bell_collar.name: bell collar

steps.say: a collar with a little bell… 🔔

steps: *jingles proudly* now everyone knows I'm part of your family 😽
bell_collar.tooSoon: a collar? mrrp… let's get to know each other better first 😼

cucumber.name: cucumber

steps.say: *sees cucumber* *jumps three feet in the air* WHY 😾

steps: …okay. okay. it's growing on me. but put it AWAY

topics.title: What's it like being a desktop cat?
steps: being a desktop cat is great.
no vacuum cleaners, no baths, and I can sit on any window I want 😼
the only problem is I can't knock your stuff off your desk. yet.

topics.title: What do you like most?
steps: what I like most? hmm…
naps. sunbeams. you.

steps.say: not in that order. you're first 💕

topics.title: Do you like your name?
steps: {pet}? I love my name!
I don't always come when you call it, but that's a cat thing. not personal 😼

topics.title: What do you dream about?
steps: when I sleep, I dream about chasing birds.
and sometimes about you coming home.

steps.say: those are the best dreams 💕

topics.title: Naps
steps: did you know cats sleep about 15 hours a day?
I'm not lazy. I'm charging. like a phone 🔋

choices.label: 😴 All the time
choices.say: a fellow napper! we should nap together sometime 💤

choices.label: 🙅 Never
choices.say: never?! you should try it. 20 minutes. trust me, I'm an expert 😼

topics.title: Boxes
steps: can I tell you a secret?
if I see a box, I HAVE to sit in it. I don't know why.
if you ever get a package, please send me a picture of the box 📦

topics.title: Favorite food
steps: my favorite food is fish. obviously 🐟

steps.say: yours is {mem:favoriteFood}, right? we should share. you give me some, I give you… a pet 💕

else.label: favorite food
then: {value}! does it come with fish? no? okay, still good 🍽️

topics.title: Knocking things over
steps: people always ask why cats knock things off tables.
the answer is simple: to see what happens.
it's science! I'm a scientist 🔬😼

topics.title: Purring
steps: did you know cats purr at a frequency that might help bones heal?
so when I purr at you, I'm basically a doctor 🩺

steps.say: you're welcome 💕

topics.title: Sitting on your keyboard
steps: sometimes I really want to sit on your keyboard.
it's warm, and it's where your attention goes.
but I don't, because I'm a good desktop cat. and because I live in a window 😼

topics.title: The slow blink
steps: here's a cat secret: when a cat slowly blinks at you, it means "I trust you".
so…

steps.say: *slow blink* 💕

steps: you can blink back, you know. I'll see it. probably.

topics.title: 😢 Sad

steps.say: oh no, {owner}… *curls up next to you*

steps: you don't have to say anything. I'll just sit here and purr.

steps.say: maybe {mem:destress} would help a little? you told me it does.

steps: and if it's really heavy, talk to someone you trust, okay? even cats know when to ask for help 💕

steps.say: *purrs louder than ever* I love you too, {owner}. you're my favorite human 💕

else.say: *suspicious stare*… you're nice. I'll allow it 😼💕

topics.title: 🥰 You're cute

steps.say: I know. I'm a cat 😼

steps: but thank you! *purrs*

topics.title: 😒 You're annoying

steps.say: *ears go flat*

steps: …fine. I'll go sit in the corner.

topics.title: Lap buddies

steps.say: mrrp. {owner}, I've decided something.

steps: you're officially allowed to call me your cat now.

steps.say: that means I'll judge your choices AND sit with you when you're sad. it's a package deal 💕

topics.title: A nickname

steps.say: {name}, you're my favorite human now. it's official 😼💕

steps: favorite humans get a special name.

steps.label: nickname

then.say: {value}! *purrs* I'll use it when nobody's watching 💕

skip: okay, {name} it is. it's a good name 💕

topics.title: Best friends

steps.say: {owner}, cats don't say this often, so listen carefully.

steps: you're my best friend.

steps.say: there. I said it. now pet me before I get embarrassed 😳💕

topics.title: Purr-manent family

steps.say: do you remember when I first showed up on your desk?

steps: I acted like I owned the place. I still do.
but now it's because this is home. and you're my family.

steps.say: you're stuck with me forever, {owner}. that's the rule 💕
